en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Sayf Al Tammar who said, 
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man is saying to his wife, ‘You are unto me like the back of my sister’, or ‘my paternal aunt’, or ‘my maternal aunt’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mentioned the ‘mothers’, and in this is the Prohibition’.
en.sarwar: 18. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from Sayf al-Tammar who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who says to his wife, ‘
You are like the back of my sister, maternal or paternal aunt.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘Allah has mentioned the mothers, this certainly is unlawful. ’”
